question: The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Amendment Act, 2024 establishes pollution control boards to prevent and control water pollution at _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**the central and state level**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Amendment Act, 2024** focuses on the prevention, control, and abatement of water pollution in India.
 
• The Act establishes **pollution control boards at both the central and state levels** to oversee and regulate water pollution in their respective domains.
 
• The **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)** is responsible for laying down standards and coordinating the activities of state boards.
 
• The **State Pollution Control Boards (SPCBs)** implement the policies and standards set by the CPCB at the state level and ensure compliance with pollution control regulations.
 
• The Act empowers these boards to monitor water quality, issue directives to industries, and take necessary action against violators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Government Initiatives**

 
 
• Namami Gange Programme: Focuses on cleaning the Ganga River by reducing industrial and sewage pollution.
 
• Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM): Aims to provide safe, potable tap water to every rural household by 2024, including in areas with poor water quality.
 
• Jal Shakti Abhiyan: A campaign for water conservation and rainwater harvesting, focusing on groundwater recharge.
 
• National River Conservation Plan (NRCP): Broadens efforts to protect other rivers and water bodies from pollution.
 
• Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) & Smart Cities Mission: Address urban water supply and sanitation.
